memos.scout:
Case for buying now (SCOUT):

The strongest signal is breadth of organic participation. The last 15 minutes show 566 unique buyers and 545 sellers against about $69.6k volume, with buy SOL of 299 versus sell SOL of 273. Net flow is still positive (+26.9 SOL), and the coin is up 46% over that window and 91% over 30 minutes. The launch was not an airdrop dump (airdrop_dump_seen is false), and top-3 holders control only 9.2% of the curve, so no single wallet dominates.

Early buyers didn't sell out either: the first 2 minutes after graduation show a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.93 and a top-5 buyer share of 13.7%, both reasonable. The 13% drawdown from the 30-minute high is modest, and the pool is 118 SOL deep.

The caveats are real: bundle share is 37%, and the buy-sell balance is close to even, so momentum is not one-sided. But the flow is still net positive and broadly distributed. I'd call this a modest case for a short, tightly sized entry, not a strong one.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss path: a sell-off from the current level, driven by the heavy distribution in the last 15 minutes. Sell SOL of 272.6 against buy SOL of 299.5 is a 0.93 sell-to-buy ratio, and net flow is only +26.9 SOL. Buyers and sellers are nearly equal (566 vs 545), so volume is churning rather than accumulating. The 36.7% bundle share on the curve and launch bot presence suggest coordinated early buyers who can exit into retail demand, and the 0.93 sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation shows they already did. With a 13.3% drawdown from the 30-minute high and a 118 SOL pool, a single wave of profit-taking can move price several percent, and a 1.4-5.1% round trip cost leaves little margin. Pass.
